newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL BEAT ARSENAL TO CLOSE GAP AT TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL BEAT ARSENAL TO CLOSE GAP AT TOP.

text.p: Liverpool closed to within three points of English premier league leaders Manchester United on Monday with a tense 2-1 win at third-placed Arsenal.
Stan Collymore opened the scoring five minutes into the second half when David Seaman failed to hold a shot by Stig Inge Bjornebye.

Seaman, playing his first game for nearly two months, thought he had made amends in the 65th minute when he saved a controversial Robbie Fowler penalty -- only for Jason McAteer to bang in the rebound.
Ian Wright pulled one back 12 minutes from time but it was too late for Arsenal who stayed six points behind United.
The night's other game, a relegation battle between Middlesbrough and Nottingham Forest ended 1-1.
Alf-Inge Haaland put Forest ahead after four minutes but Mikkel Beck equalised for Middlesbrough in the 56th.
